Host-observed edges and guest E2→E3g. Warmup excluded, both batches of each freeze pooled (n=60 recorded per config). E3w is first-connect plus the pcap-relative SYN/ACK→HTTP interval (D-0043); E3w→E4 is `e0_to_e4_ns − e0_to_e3w_ns`. Those two metrics are retired (D-0070 / D-0071) and retained here only as the record of the mislabeling.

Baseline sourced from `git show baseline-t4.3:results/{runs,phases}.csv`. After-ladder sourced from `git show c40945cdb71b5aef68c5e72e292a718b66ec651e:results/{runs,phases}.csv`.

### T4.8 Whimbrel arms (`ffb7ac71234e`, new schema)

Same host and QEMU as the cross-system campaign; three Linux arms interleaved. `csum=off` / TSO-family off on the shared virtio-net-device args (no-op for Whimbrel). E0→first-connect is a control. W is guest-boot wait (SYN/ACK − slirp ARP), Whimbrel-only — it does not appear on the cross-system table. Never E0→E3w / E3w→E4.
